description: This is a round, plush ottoman with a distinctive segmented design, reminiscent of a pumpkin or a melon. The fabric is upholstered in a soft, light green color with thin, vertical white stripes, creating a subtle textured appearance. The segmentation is achieved through stitching that divides the surface into multiple panels, converging at the top and bottom, giving it a decorative and inviting look. It appears to be made of a soft, cushioned material suitable for resting feet or as extra seating.
